quarterly_data.signal: 10-K regulation and NGS manufacturing: Twist believes most of its products as currently marketed are largely unregulated by the FDA apart from labeling requirements, but it supports customers developing regulated products through contract manufacturing and specialized packaging, its quality management system adheres to ISO 13485:2016, an external third party has determined it has processes in place to support compliance with current Good Manufacturing Practices, and it anticipates further engagement with regulators such as the FDA if it expands its own portfolio of IVDs. It still manufactures a significant portion of its NGS products at its South San Francisco facility, while its Express product line is manufactured solely in Wilsonville.

10-K fiscal 2025 financials: revenues were $376,572 thousand versus $312,974 thousand (+20%) and net loss was $77,670 thousand versus $208,726 thousand. By region, Americas revenue was $225,580 thousand, EMEA $124,240 thousand and APAC $26,752 thousand. By industry, industrial chemicals/materials customers provided $93,246 thousand (25%), academic research $65,861 thousand (17%) and food/agriculture $2,373 thousand (1%).
